R16b.name: h is lost before two consonants or a single word-final consonant

R20.name: degemination (r + r > r, k + k > k)

R7.name: i + a, a + i > ii
R7.source: Parks 7; BB L3 rule 5 (i + a > e)

R9.name: word-final s is lost in certain nouns and suffixes

V+V ʔ.name: ʔ between two vowels that do not contract
V+V ʔ.source: data; consistent with the conditions under which Parks says vowels do not contract (Major Sound Changes, Vowels: Unrestricted Rules)

V:>V/_hC.name: a long vowel shortens before h + consonant

w>p/C_.name: w > p after a hard consonant
